items.evidence_summary: Fresh Website Developer consulting engagement surfaced 2026-09-03 for Spain/remote. The role is explicitly contract/freelance-oriented and seeks a long-term technical partner for a PHP-based CMS website, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, maintenance, deployments, accessibility, security, performance/Core Web Vitals, analytics/SEO and CRM/form integrations, with a small recurring retainer plus additional project work.
items.why_high_value: Excellent truthful VDS overlap in frontend, PHP/CMS, performance, Core Web Vitals, maintenance, integrations and troubleshooting, with explicit recurring consulting potential.
verified_facts: Contract/freelance consulting model is stated in upstream current evidence.
Spain/remote compatibility is stated in current discovery evidence.
PHP CMS, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, maintenance, security, accessibility and Core Web Vitals are materially relevant requirements.
inferences: WordPress experience is transferable to the PHP-CMS maintenance scope, but MODX-specific depth must not be claimed unless verified.
The recurring retainer plus project work could develop into a durable client relationship.
safe_alternative_angles: Manual application through Breezy emphasizing PHP/CMS adaptability, frontend delivery, Core Web Vitals, maintenance, integrations and pragmatic troubleshooting without claiming MODX expertise.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not substitute a guessed or generic email for the official Breezy application route.
Do not claim MODX-specific seniority or expertise not established by the VDS profile.
recommended_human_checks: Confirm the Breezy application remains open.
Review any mandatory portfolio/CV fields and use only approved public-document links where appropriate.
Confirm exact remote/cross-border contracting wording before submission.

items.evidence_summary: Current official agency pages state that Say What? works with a network of freelance professionals and creatives across Italy and invites people who want to join the team to send a CV. The official site also exposes info@saywhat.it, but available evidence does not prove that the generic mailbox is the authoritative CV/application route or that a current web-development slot is open.
items.why_high_value: Explicit recurring freelance-network model at an established Italian communication/digital agency creates plausible agency-overflow potential, while the official CV invitation indicates active talent-network openness.
verified_facts: Official site states collaboration with freelance professionals/creatives.
Official site invites candidates to send a CV.
info@saywhat.it is an official public general contact.
inferences: The freelance network may include external web/frontend production, but that specialization is not explicitly confirmed by the current invitation.
The general mailbox may or may not be the intended CV route.
safe_alternative_angles: Human review of the CV link/route, then a concise external web-production/overflow collaboration approach only if the route is confirmed appropriate.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not automatically send to the general mailbox until it is confirmed as an appropriate collaboration/CV route.
Do not describe the agency as actively hiring a web developer without explicit evidence.
recommended_human_checks: Open the official CV/join-team link and identify its exact destination.
Verify whether web/frontend/digital-production freelance profiles are currently accepted.
If route authority is confirmed, position VDS as overflow/production support rather than as a response to an invented vacancy.
